item.title: The Loyalty Deficit: Is Developer Community a Retention Moat in the AI Race?
item.description: A testable case that developer community is a retention moat in the AI race - what lift it needs per percent of ARR spent, a CFO-ready scorecard, and a decision gate with a stop rule.
